text.en:
Port of Currimao. The territorial jurisdiction of the Port of Currimao situated in
the Municipality of Currimao, Province of locos Norte, is hereby delineated and established,
particularly described as follows:
Beginning at a point marked 1 on the plan, thence:
00'
00
00'
00'
1,700.00 m. to point of beginning,
Containing a total area of ONE MILLION SIX HUNDRED FIFTY-SEVEN THOUSAND FIVE
HUNDRED (1,657,500) SQUARE METERS, more or less.

PPA Jurisdiction. The Currimao Port Zone, as delineated, is hereby placed
under the administrative jurisdiction of the PA, which shall, consistent with the regional industrial
plans of the government, implement a program for the proper zoning, planning, development and
utilization of the port.

Repeal. All issuances, orders, rules and regulations, or parts thereof, which are
inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby repealed, amended or modified accordingly.

Separability. If any provision of this Executive Order is declared invalid or
unconstitutional, the other provisions not affected thereby shall remain valid and subsisting.

Effectivity. This Executive Order shall take effect immediately upon publication
in a newspaper of general circulation.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 4th
Thousand and Twelve.
